summary: An excerpt from a novel (Book 10, part 12) following Zbigkrot, a productive monk in the Order whose work includes screening Securitat data streams for unusual purchase patterns, and his past connection to a sister, Anja Krotoski, who once lived on 23d Street in New York. Lawrence, watching the city from outside Anja's old building, reflects on the faces city-dwellers wear in public versus the relaxed selves they become once they cross their own threshold. The passage blends workplace detail, Zbigkrot's hobbies, and Lawrence's memories of Belgrade and his earlier life.
one_line: In a novel excerpt, monk Zbigkrot's Order work and lost sister Anja are observed by Lawrence outside her decaying New York building.
key_facts: Zbigkrot spent his 20 percent time building aerial photography rigs out of box-kites and tiny cameras.
The aerial rigs were meant to help monks monitor their body mechanics and ergonomic posture.
Zbigkrot performed in the eighty-fifth percentile of the Order.
Lawrence's own performance had ranged from as low as 70 to as high as 88 percentile.
Zbigkrot worked in the gardens, including a little allotment garden for baroque cross-breeding experiments.
Lawrence believed the Securitat stream Zbigkrot altered was probably purchase data from hardware and grocery stores, inspected for bomb-ingredient buying patterns.
Zbigkrot had added sixty-eight bytes to the Securitat stream and then left.
Zbigkrot had worked on this kind of data thousands of times, six times just that day.
Zbigkrot's sister Anja Krotoski had lived on 23d Street in a co-op near Lexington in New York.
Anja had lived there four years earlier, when Zbigkrot joined the Order, and her phone numbers all rang dead.
Anja's old building once had a red awning and a niche for a doorman, but the doorman was gone and a lobby pane was replaced with cardboard.
Lawrence compared the neglected buildings to ones he saw in Belgrade while briefing a gang of outsource programmers.
Lawrence watched residents enter the building at dinner hour with hard city-dweller masks that changed once the door closed behind them.
Lawrence remembered from his earlier life the feeling of having two faces.
